pattern: Log (WAI-ARIA role=log) of messages as articles, with a polite live region announcement per finished message; the composer is a labelled multi-line text field.

roles.role: log (aria-live off; announcements go through the shared polite live region)
article, named by its author and time
group ('Message actions') of native buttons; thumbs up and down are toggle buttons (aria-pressed)
figure with a caption (language) and a scrollable, focusable pre

aria.value: off: streamed text is not read token by token

keyboard.action: Show earlier messages, the log (scrollable), links, code blocks, attachment chips, message actions, Jump to latest, suggestions, then the composer.

keyboard.key: Arrow keys / Page Up / Page Down / Home / End

keyboard.action: Activate (copy, rate, retry, open attachment, suggestion, jump).
Send (Shift+Enter for a new line; configurable).

focus: Focus stays where it is when messages arrive. Jump to latest moves focus to the newest message; Show earlier messages keeps focus on its button and keeps the reading position.
notes: While a reply streams, assistive technology hears '<name> is typing' once, then the finished reply (first 300 characters), or 'Reply stopped' or 'Reply failed'.
New messages from others (addMessage) are announced; the user's own messages are not.
The typing dots are decorative; the typing text is available to assistive technology.
Auto-scroll stops while the user reads earlier messages, so content never moves under the reader (WCAG 2.2.2).
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
